pages.title: Consumer Mini Fusion Reactor
pages.text: A tiny magical furnace that works from your inventory. Sealing the gap in its lid traps the escaping heat, so it is put to efficient use and the internal space is better packed.

$(bold)Changing its mood$()$(br)Left-click the hakkero in the middle to cycle through $(bold)OFF → Smoker → Furnace → Blast Furnace$(). Each mode accepts the recipes of that type.$(br2)The hakkero heats the inventory slots around it and puts finished results out on the outside. Leave room around it for items to move.$(br2)Put in a dye and the heating rate rises sharply.
